chapter.v:
Then Bildad
the Shuhite spoke up and said,

“Dominion and
awe belong to God. He brings peace to his heavens.

Who can
count his armies? Is there anywhere his light doesn't shine?

How can
a human being be right before God? Can anyone born of woman be pure?

If in
God's eyes even the moon does not shine brightly, and the stars are not pure,

how much
less a human being—who by comparison is like a maggot or a worm!”
